verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships a single-binary local install and clickhouse-local that runs full SQL analytics without any account, cloud dependency, or server process, confirmed by hands-on runtime probes (curl install, version check, real CREATE/INSERT/SELECT roundtrip) — ideal for offline dev and CI. missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline example/doc showing clickhouse-local used inside a CI test suite, only implied by the keyless local-file processing capability.
